```{python}
from render import make_regression_table
from specs import (
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    jobloss,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    update_formula_search_replace,
)

temperature_measure_specs = [
    ("tmean_7d_dev", "7-day mean temperature deviation"),
    ("hot30_7d_dev", "7-day hot-day count deviation"),
    ("heatwave_7d_dev", "7-day heatwave-day count deviation"),
]

main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock, jobloss]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]

temperature_measure_previews = [
    {
        "measure": measure,
        "label": label,
        "main_specs": [
            update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", measure)
            for spec in main_shock_specs
        ],
        "panel_specs": [
            update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", measure)
            for spec in panel_shock_specs
        ],
    }
    for measure, label in temperature_measure_specs
]
```


## Main Table

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{python}
make_regression_table(specs=temperature_measure_previews[0]["main_specs"])
```
